why: Item 1 is met: builder step 7 says to run `npm install` at the root so package-lock.json includes the workspace, "otherwise `npm ci` in CI fails". Item 2 is met: step 6 says to "replace the 'No tools yet' bullet". Item 4 is met: Check 6 reads the body and headRefOid with gh pr view and requires the test check "at the head commit succeeded". Item 3 fails. Check 4 runs the workspace tests directly, and Check 6 only requires that root `npm ci && npm test` "passes". Nothing reads the test count from the root run or breaks lint() to see a test fail, so the verifier would not notice the tests being skipped under `--if-present`.
